customManagers.description: Creality Print release installed by the Dockerfile

packageRules.description: Bundle all tooling updates (base image digest, GitHub Actions, Playwright, Docker CLI, ...) into one PR, at most once a week, majors included.

Creality Print releases get their own PR as soon as they appear: that's the update users notice. Track every plain vX.Y.Z release, including ones GitHub flags as prerelease (creality.com distributes those as current; docs/research). Suffixed tags (-Beta, -rc) are excluded.
